name: ANSI/IEEE light-dependent resistor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for light-dependent resistor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The light-dependent resistor form identifies a resistive component affected by illumination. Its sensing modifier describes the physical influence rather than a new electrical terminal, while the surrounding circuit translates the resistance change into a usable signal.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the electrical leads independently of the optical indication.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An LDR changes resistance; a photodiode has a semiconductor junction and different measurement behaviour.
